# Vargov Design

> Vargov® Design is a Russian brand of author's lighting and decorative compositions: collectible light sculptures in art glass, crystal, ceramics and metal. Founded and led by designer Anton Vargov. Own production, made to order — every composition is assembled for a specific interior, its scale and geometry adjusted to the space. Trademark VARGOV No. 896936.

The catalogue holds 605 compositions with LC article codes (LC0001…LC0602) in four families. 23 international awards.

## Canonical source

The brand's primary machine-readable map lives on the site itself and is generated from its data:

- [vargov.ru/llms.txt](https://vargov.ru/llms.txt) — full map: facts, sections, contacts, language versions.

This repository is a supporting knowledge base: verified facts, awards with links to primary sources, press materials.

VARGOV trademark: Russia, registration No. 896936 (to 29 April 2032); international registration under the Madrid System No. 1 795 801 with protection in China (to 20 May 2034), class 11 — lighting apparatus.

## About

- [About the brand](https://vargov.ru/en/about) · [Anton Vargov](https://vargov.ru/en/designer) · [Awards](https://vargov.ru/en/awards) · [Projects](https://vargov.ru/en/projects) · [Journal](https://vargov.ru/en/journal) · [Press kit](https://vargov.ru/en/press) · [Showroom](https://vargov.ru/en/showroom) · [Official dealers](https://vargov.ru/en/official-dealers)
- [Russian Lighting Design: Where It Comes From and What It Looks Like Today](https://vargov.ru/en/journal/russian-lighting-design) — essay in the site journal (5 September 2026), eight languages; text copy in this base: en/guides/russian-lighting-design.md

23 awards across 15 programmes (official names): MUSE Design Awards, IDA Design Awards, LIT Lighting Design Awards, LOOP Design Awards, SIT Furniture Design Award, Luxury Lifestyle Awards, ADD Awards, European Product Design Award, NY Product Design Awards, BLT Built Design Awards, The London Design Awards, International Architecture & Design Awards · ADC, Houzee Awards, Interlight Russia · Russian Lighting Design, Awwwards (Nominee 2026 for the 3D configurator — a nomination, not a win).

Among them: Platinum Winner — MUSE Design Awards 2023, International Architecture & Design Awards · ADC 2023, The London Design Awards 2023; Product Designer of the Year — NY Product Design Awards 2023; Gold Winner — MUSE Design Awards 2026 ("Oceanic Illumination"), NY Product Design Awards 2023, ADC 2023 ("Drapery"), Houzee Awards 2023.

In 2022 the brand took the special prize of the Russian Lighting Design competition at Interlight; in October 2025 it exhibited at Interlight Moscow with its first own stand.
